definitions: I lifted something from a surface.
I learned something new, often informally.
I collected someone or something, often by car.
I resumed something after an interruption.
I improved or recovered, especially in health or business.
examples: I picked up the book from the floor.
I picked up some Spanish phrases on my trip.
I picked up my friend from the station.
I picked up a strange signal on the radio.
I picked up where I left off in the story.
I picked up after a period of illness.
